summary: This note is a short biographical entry for Harry Heitmann, an American former Major League Baseball pitcher. It gives his full name and dates of birth and death, and notes that he appeared in one MLB game. That game was a start for the Brooklyn Robins against the St. Louis Cardinals during the 1918 season.
one_line: Harry Heitmann was a Major League Baseball pitcher who made one start for the 1918 Brooklyn Robins.
key_facts: Henry Anton "Harry" Heitmann was born October 6, 1896.
Harry Heitmann was a pitcher in Major League Baseball (MLB).
Harry Heitmann pitched in one MLB game.
That game was for the Brooklyn Robins during the 1918 baseball season.
Heitmann got the start against the St. Louis Cardinals on July 27, 1918.
The game was the second game of a doubleheader.
